tasks.IsolateSquareRoots: Isolates square roots on one side of the equation to prepare for squaring both sides.
tasks.SimplifyInnerExpression: Simplifies the inner expression of the given equation.
tasks.SolveQuadraticEquation: Solves the resulting quadratic equation after squaring both sides.
tasks.SquareBothSides: Squares both sides of the simplified equation to eliminate square roots.
